description: This file is the main entry point for a Tic Tac Toe mobile application, featuring the game logic, user interface, and state management for the game.

methods.name: calculateWinner
methods.description: Determines the winner of the game based on the current board state. Returns 'X', 'O', 'draw', or null.

methods.name: handlePress
methods.description: Handles the player's move on the game board when a cell is pressed.

methods.name: fadeFlash
methods.description: Animates the status bar to provide visual feedback when the game ends.

methods.name: handleReset
methods.description: Resets the game state to start a new game.
